spec_basis: docs/type-directed-optimization-plan.md §5.1 (N-spike: hand-written codegen-target Zig, richards-typed module, 3-5 person-days, deliverables a+b), §5.2 (boundary crossing tiers; crossing costs measured at spike time)

scope.native_arm: hand-write the Zig that the AOT emitter SHOULD emit for one richards-typed microbench module; statically link against the zjs runtime; execute vs the interpreter on identical fixed work
scope.boundary_set: native->interp single crossing, interp->native single crossing, round-trip ping-pong; each at the four tiers: generic wrapper / descriptor / direct call / batched API
scope.explicitly_out: no emitter, no compiler pipeline, no F3/F5 — the arm is hand-written by construction

primary_metric: paired fixed-work time ratio, richards-typed module: native arm vs interpreter (insn+cycles recorded together)

thresholds.pass: >= 2.0x (paper anchor for typed OO code is 2-4x at baseline-JIT-grade code quality; the spike must reach the anchor's floor)
thresholds.redesign: 1.3x - 2.0x: real but below anchor -> recalibrate the v1 AOT scope/claims before G1-AOT rules
thresholds.fail: < 1.3x: the native thesis does not survive contact with the real runtime boundary

required_artifacts: (a) measured native-arm multiple on zjs — first real anchor against the 2-4x paper number
(b) engineering form + pitfall list for GC/exception/boundary integration — REQUIRED REGARDLESS OF VERDICT (doc: deliverable b)
boundary cost table: cycles per crossing per tier, plus round-trip
correctness_gates: module output checksums identical to the interpreter run
conservative-scan root visibility: collection forced while native frames hold heap references, under -Dzjs_gc=trace_stw
exception crossing: JS exception thrown under a native frame propagates via status return with correct backtrace kind marks

maximum_regression.rule: none applicable to shipped code (spike links its own binary); interpreter binary untouched

sample_protocol: measurement contract (sha256 020f2f18...); >=8 paired ABBA samples, pinned big core, CV <= 5%

verdicts.pass: >= 2.0x + correctness green -> G1-AOT=eligible; BACKEND-ORDER prices it against G1-JIT; v1 scope defined from the measured data
verdicts.redesign: 1.3-2.0x -> rescope (e.g. numeric-core-only claims, boundary-density limits) and re-rule
verdicts.fail: < 1.3x -> G1-AOT=later; typed value stays as backend-input and typed-FFI lines
